category_title: Students with specialized home-based expertise who act as peer mentors
minimal_context: The student is participating in a weaving activity during art class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today in art class, we are studying weaving. Please begin working on the weaving assignment with your group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: My father taught me to weave purses!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is nice. Let's just focus on the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am the master weaver. I can be the team leader and assist the others in my group.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just do your own weaving right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But I am proud to tell you what my father taught me. I want to collaborate and assist the others with their weaving instead of just sitting here.
